title: Ultra-low-loading RuW nanoclusters coupled with W single atoms for efficient anion exchange membrane fuel cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04114G, Paper
Qingping Yu, Rong Liu, Licheng Wei, Zhenying Zheng, Lifeng Zhang, Hu Yang, Qingyu Kong, Jihao Zhang, Zhiwei Hu, Qilei Song, Xiaoping Gao, Nanjun Chen, Xiaoqing Huang
We present Ru–W nanoclusters integrated with W single atoms on a N-doped carbon substrate (RuW/W–NC) for AEMFCs, where RuW/W–NC with a Ru loading of 0.1 mg cm−2 achieves a high power density of 2.03 W cm−2 and can be run stably at 1 A cm−2 for 100 h.
